# Health Authorities

This folder catalogs the official web domains operated by Danish health authorities and clinical quality organizations. It currently holds the primary digital hub for the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), which serves as the central administrative repository for national clinical databases, methodological frameworks, and annual healthcare quality reports.

## Pages

- [[www-rkkp-dk|www.rkkp.dk]] — The official web portal for the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program, hosting critical publications like the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database annual reports and anticoagulation wait-time metrics.
